text: {"final": {"steps": [{"id": "P1", "file": "logistics/access.py", "change": "Fix the module docstring (line 4) so RESTRICTED ('R') is documented as 'light vehicles only (vans); heavy trucks may not use it' instead of 'closed to all vehicles'. Then add can_pass(road_id: str, vehicle: str, network: dict | None = None) -> bool: get the status via the existing road_status(road_id, network) (which raises KeyError/ValueError for unknown road/status); return False if status is CLOSED ('X'); if status is RESTRICTED ('R'), return True only when VEHICLE_WEIGHT[vehicle] == 'light' (i.e. vans pass, trucks do not); if status is OPEN ('A'), return True for any vehicle.", "uses": ["R1", "R2", "R11"], "after": []}, {"id": "P2", "file": "logistics/routes.py", "change": "Add passable_route(warehouse_id: str, site: str, network: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict, str] | None: load the network if None (same pattern as best_route), get candidate routes via routes_between(warehouse_id, site, network); a route is usable if can_pass(road_id, 'truck', network) is True for every road in r['roads'] or can_pass(road_id, 'van', network) is True for every road. Among usable routes pick the shortest with the same tie-break as best_route (min by (r['km'], r['id'])); return (route, 'truck') if a truck may use every road on it, else (route, 'van'); return None if no route is usable. Leave best_route unchanged. Also add rerouted_sites(network: dict | None = None) -> list[str]: for each site served (reuse sites_served per warehouse, or iterate warehouses/sites as needed), include the site when passable_route returns a route whose id differs from the route id best_route picks (a vehicle-only change does not count; if either returns None the site is not rerouted); return sites sorted by name, following the ordering pattern of sites_served.", "uses": ["R3", "R4", "R10"], "after": ["P1"]}, {"id": "P3", "file": "notifications/sms.py", "change": "Add notify_rerouted(sites: list[str], day: str) -> list[SmsMessage]: iterate load_households(active_only=True) from registry/register.py; for each household whose .site is in sites and whose .sms_ok is True, call queue_sms(household.id, 'DELIVERY_MOVED', {'site': household.site, 'day': day}) using the existing TEMPLATES['DELIVERY_MOVED'] template; collect and return the messages sent (one text per matching household).", "uses": ["R5", "R6", "R7", "R8"], "after": []}, {"id": "P4", "file": "distribution/planner.py", "change": "In build_plan, replace the call to best_route(warehouse, hh.site, network) with passable_route(warehouse, hh.site, network) from logistics/routes.py. When it returns (route, vehicle), set delivery.route_id = route['id'] and delivery.vehicle = vehicle (so trucks are used whenever the route allows and vans otherwise); when it returns None, keep setting delivery.status = 'unreachable'. This ensures no delivery is planned on a road its vehicle may not use.", "uses": ["R9"], "after": ["P2"]}]}}
